title: Contract-First Epistemology: Full Course Syllabus and Audit Receipt
object_of_study: The full twenty-eight-week teaching route treated as an evaluable object: what the course is, what it teaches, how it is sequenced, what students produce, and what counts as completion.
main_question: Is the full teaching route structurally declared enough to be taught, assessed, repaired, and transmitted without author mediation?

claim_layers.claim: The syllabus receipt (Receipt ID CFE.SYLLABUS-RECEIPT.v1.0) provides a compact audit view of the full twenty-eight-week structure, designed to be read before the main course body is assessed; it treats the course itself as an evaluable object.

Scope: front matter, course body, back matter, Teaching Kit, templates, ledgers, readiness checks, rubrics, and final transmission instruments. Out of scope: empirical pilot results, live cohort performance, institutional approval, instructor-specific adaptations, and domain-specific course variants.

The course architecture is structurally declared (source-stated); classroom efficacy is a separate, not-yet-evaluable claim that the source itself says should not be asserted as proven until it returns through actual instruction, student artifacts, assessment records, and repair evidence.

Distinct-object test: the file carries a compact audit/receipt burden (its own receipt identity, scope, out-of-scope list, mandate, non-goal, and reader result) rather than repeating the course body; the library therefore registers it as a distinct witness.

source_boundary: The governing source is SRC-000058 ("Contract-First Epistemology: Full Course Syllabus and Audit Receipt"). The source establishes only what its own public record and text state; everything classified here under the current Structura Reditus architecture (Tier-2 class, structural focus, evidence mode, maturity) is library interpretation and is not attributed to the source. The receipt audits course architecture; live cohort performance and institutional approval are out of its scope by its own declaration.
authority_boundary: This is a Tier-2 Research Library object. Library admission does not grant Tier-0 protocol authority or Tier-1 kernel authority, canon status, proof, weld, scientific endorsement, or release status.
scope: A fourteen-page compact audit receipt for the complete course architecture: course identity, mandate, non-goal, sequence, expected student products, completion standard, and reader result.
exclusions: Does not repeat every lecture, worksheet, rubric, or teaching instrument.
Does not report empirical pilot results or live cohort performance.
preserved_meaning: The full-course audit surface and the distinction between structural readiness and unproven classroom efficacy.

missingness.notes: Out of the receipt's declared scope; NON_EVALUABLE pending student artifacts and transmission evidence. Distinct from structural conformance.

missingness.item: separate record description for this member work
missingness.notes: The archive description describes the full course.

distortion_or_substitution_risk: Reading the audit receipt as evidence that the course has been taught or has worked, or reading it as merely another copy of the full course.
next_burden: Live use of the receipt by an instructor, reviewer, or institution to assess, repair, or transmit the course, producing actual student/evaluator artifacts; classroom efficacy remains unproven until then.
repair_route: Supply the missing structure from the source work or its archive record (never from inference); if a source DOI does not resolve to the titled work, supply the DOI that does. Resubmit the same ObjectID; all seven gates are re-evaluated.
